title: KrishokChat T08 Pilot Item Schema v1
description: Frozen pilot item format for the annotation pilot. Each item is a self-contained unit of analysis (query + answer + evidence passage) drawn from the DEVELOPMENT pool only. Labelers annotate per T07_label_manual_v1 and produce labels that conform to T07_claim_schema_v1; raw labels retain annotator ID and lineage per T07 section 6.

item_id.description: Pilot item ID. Stable across label sets.

split_pool.description: Never 'test'. Test data must not be used for piloting or label tuning.

t09_group.description: Union-find intent group from T09 split manifest.

answer.description: Answer text to be split into atomic claims before labeling.

chemical_trace.description: Chemicals named in the answer (from generation metadata).

source_md.description: Absolute path of the source passage file (may not exist on the labeler's machine).

evidence_status.description: attached = evidence_text populated; otherwise labelers must flag that no evidence passage was available.

content_hash.description: SHA-256 of the source passage file.

evidence_text.description: First 4000 chars of the source passage; the labeling basis.

annotators.description: Filled when annotation runs. Raw labels never replaced by consensus (T07 section 6).
